policy.fiveSecondToleranceAppliesTo: Positive target start and end error only.
policy.protectionRule: Every raw overlap with explicit protected ranges, protected interval categories, title markers, or excluded additional segments is recorded. Any overlap above one microsecond is a violation.
policy.targetRule: Frozen semantic targets are preserved, including Hubble opening-title blocks and One Step Beyond sponsored openings. A negative is determined by label content, never the directory name.
policy.safeHitRule: Exactly one published interval, both endpoints within five seconds, and no protected-content violation.
policy.emptyOutputRule: Abstention does not establish positive recognition. Precision and endpoint error are null for no output.

earlierDevelopmentRetention.status: Preserved earlier eighteen-case development result; do not add its sample count to the final replay.

positive.scope: First retained attempt on three new independent Robin Hood episode works, using uniformly preselected 512Kb renditions.

negative.scope: First retained attempt on three new independent Space to Ground short-ident negatives; N400 was selected before source review after bounded discovery did not locate N397.

selectionAndReviewDisclosures.robinRendition: All three Robin Hood sources use metadata-listed 512Kb MPEG4 renditions selected uniformly before download and source review. Timing and resolution can differ from prior encodings; source PTS and source hashes define these cases.
selectionAndReviewDisclosures.nasaSelectionException: N397 was not found by bounded official discovery. N398, N399, and N400 were selected before source acquisition, labeling, or candidate execution. The unavailable N397 is not a tested case.
selectionAndReviewDisclosures.coordinatorExposureDisclosure: The source-label coordinator had seen prior implementation and score summaries. Two fresh source reviewers without inherited algorithm context supplied all classifications and boundaries; integration retained their case labels and added source metadata only.

limitations: Assistant source labels are not human ground truth and have no direct audio listening.
Finite non-random cases do not establish new-series, new-season, or population accuracy.
Protection conclusions are bounded by retained labels and sampled source review.
Nine positive regression cases from Beverly Hillbillies, Hubblecast, and One Step Beyond remain misses; their original positive target definitions were not changed.
Original N388 through N390 labels lack source SHA-256 fields; the other twenty-four retained source identities are label-verified.
All twenty-seven retained cases have been available for development and are not an unseen generalization estimate.
The six new cases are reported separately and retain the rendition, replacement, and source-review context disclosures in their dedicated summary.
